name: Takatsuji Ikuno
source:
Childhood friend of protagonist. Has loved the protagonist since she was a kid and dotes on him every chance she gets. But when other people take interest in him romantically she becomes very jealous and violent. 

[spoiler] Accidentally wished on magic book that she would always be close to protagonist but he would also struggle most of his life.  [/spoiler]
